title: Fix OR-1 family-diversity mislabeling + revalidate existing phase-1 artifacts
plan: excava_engines.family_of() derives a draft's model family from the engine that actually answered; excava_chat.py's 4 OR-1 phase functions now label + gate on that instead of the requested family; or1_revalidate_phase1() corrects the 10 already-committed phase-1 artifacts in place.
outcome: Found + fixed a real bug in OR-1 (excava_chat.py phase1-4): every draft was labeled with the REQUESTED model family, not the one that actually answered, because pool.get(fam['engine']) can miss (families() reports a lineage 'live' from available()/keys, while or1_phaseN builds its pool from the narrower healthy()/canary set) and engines.complete() then silently substitutes a different engine. The 'ok' gate also only counted successful-draft COUNT, never distinct real families, so it could never have caught this. Net effect verified on the actual on-disk artifacts the GH Actions beat produced since fire 115: 6 of 10 element types' phase-1 'ok:true' result had ALL 4 agents actually answered by the SAME single model (mistral-small-latest) wearing 4 different family badges (GLM-5.2/DeepSeek V4/Kimi K2.7/GPT-4o-mini) -- zero real diversity behind a claimed success, on the exact rule OR-1 exists to enforce ('same-model-with-a-prompt-twist is banned'). Fixed both bugs: added engines.family_of() to derive a family from the real answering engine, wired it into all 4 phase functions (drafts now carry both 'family' [real] and 'requested_family' [intended]), and changed each phase's ok-gate to require >= min_families DISTINCT real families among successful drafts, not just a success count. Added or1_revalidate_phase1() and ran it once over the 10 committed artifacts: 5 stayed ok:true with corrected real-family labels (Llama-3.3 70B + Mistral -- still only 2 generic fallback lineages, not the intended core GLM/DeepSeek/Kimi/Qwen roster, worth a follow-up), 5 flipped to honest ok:false (connector/design/format/creation/package -- single real model, mislabeled as 4). Verified: python -m src.or1_phase_test 47/47 (3 new regression checks added proving the mislabel is fixed and that the gate now catches collapsed real diversity even when every draft superficially 'succeeded'); python -m src.excava_core_test all pass; python -m src.guardrails 18/20, 0 critical (same 2 pre-existing non-critical staleness misses, G-C/G-O, unrelated); JSON integrity clean on the rewritten artifacts; git diff reviewed file-by-file. HARSH SELF-CRITICISM: this invalidates a chunk of what fires 111-115 and PULSE.md reported as forward progress on OR-1 -- the 'all 10 types finally succeeded' milestone the last fire's log celebrated was half fake. I did not attempt to re-run phase1 for the 5 now-blocked types from this session (still single-live-family here, would just reproduce the same structural block fires 113-115 already diagnosed) -- that still needs the GH Actions beat's fuller key set, and even the beat's real key set is evidently NOT reliably reaching the core GLM/DeepSeek/Kimi lineages (OPENROUTER_API_KEY-backed) since every real draft observed used Llama-3.3-family or Mistral fallbacks instead -- worth a direct check of which secrets bulk_analyze.yml actually carries, flagged in QUESTIONS.md rather than guessed at here.
